mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, o.project_id AS projectId, o.session_id AS sessionId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.start_time AS startTime, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.quantity AS quantity, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, rr.refund_rule_id AS refundRuleId, rr.refund_type AS refundType, st.stage_id AS stageId, st.fee_rate AS feeRate, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, #{now}, s.start_time) AS beforeStartMinutes FROM ticket_order o JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refund_rule rr ON rr.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN refund_rule_stage st ON st.refund_rule_id = rr.refund_rule_id AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, #{now}, s.start_time) >= st.min_before_start_minutes AND ( st.max_before_start_minutes IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, #{now}, s.start_time) < st.max_before_start_minutes ) WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY st.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.order_id AS orderId, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.fee_amount AS feeAmount, r.apply_time AS applyTime, r.refund_time AS refundTime, r.fail_reason AS failReason FROM refund_record r JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.refund_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record ( refund_no, order_id, refund_rule_id, matched_stage_id, refund_type_snapshot, fee_rate_snapshot, apply_time, reason, refund_amount, fee_amount, refund_status, refund_time, fail_reason, update_time ) VALUES ( #{refundNo}, #{orderId}, #{refundRuleId}, #{matchedStageId}, #{refundTypeSnapshot}, #{feeRateSnapshot}, #{applyTime}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{feeAmount}, #{refundStatus}, NULL, NULL, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET refund_hold_status = ticket_status, refund_hold_abnormal_reason = abnormal_reason, ticket_status = 'EXPIRED', expire_time = #{now}, abnormal_reason = #{reason}, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('UNUSED', 'GENERATING', 'ERROR') AND refund_hold_status IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_id AS orderId, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount FROM refund_record r JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.refund_id = #{refundId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'EXPIRED', qr_code_value = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = CASE WHEN expire_time IS NULL THEN #{now} ELSE expire_time END, abnormal_reason = '退款成功，电子票已失效', refund_hold_status = NULL, refund_hold_abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ( ticket_status IN ('UNUSED', 'GENERATING', 'ERROR') OR (ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' AND refund_hold_status IS NOT NULL) )
